aspd.shield_penalty_rule: Applies ONLY when equipping an actual shield (slot==='shield' and NOT orb/catalyst/lantern/shuriken/saya and NOT ammo/quiver)
aspd.templar_base_aspd_note: templar is omitted from $n and falls back to $n.novice = 148
aspd.card_aspd_non_stacking_rule: Ho() uses Math.max() across all slotted card ASPD values; only the single highest card ASPD counts (gear/set/potion ASPD stack normally)

why_agi_aspd_matters_for_templar: Basic attacks gain +1.5% damage per ASPD point above 170 (up to +34.5% at 193 ASPD).

Sacred Guillotine Chain (sacredguillotine) triggers every 5 normal attacks for 4 sacred chain hits (90%..190% ATK base with +10% escalating per hit = 4.6x Hit 1 = 874% ATK total at Lv.10, +10% crit dmg on final hit). At 193 ASPD (7.143 attacks/s), it fires 1.43 times/sec (~1,249% ATK/s before crits); at 1 AGI (~150 ASPD, 1.0 attack/s), it fires only once every 5.0s (~175% ATK/s).

Colossus Radiant Bash (colossusbash, Lionheart Aegis) has a 15%..35% chance on every normal attack to deal 50%..115% ATK + 2%..6% MaxHP (crittable). Scales linearly with attacks/sec (0.35 procs/s at 150 ASPD vs 2.50 procs/s at 193 ASPD).
Between Shield Sacrificial Strike (2s CD) and Grand Light Devastation (10s CD), Templar spends most frames auto-attacking.

hit_flee_dodge.player_hit: floor((100 + level + total.dex * 2 + floor(total.luk / 3) + passive.hit + (isKunai ? passive.kunaiHit : 0) + gearCardSet.hit) * (1 + passive.hitPct) * (mQuake ? 0.85 : 1))
hit_flee_dodge.player_flee: floor((level + total.agi * 2 + floor(total.luk / 5) + gearCardSet.flee) * (1 + passive.fleePct + buff.fleePct)) + (buff.stats.flee ?? 0)

atk_matk_basic.atk_base: (10 + atk_stat_scale + floor(total.luk / 10) + (level - 1) * 0.3) * F + floor(bodyHp * passive.maxHpAtkPct + hit * passive.atkPerHit + total.dex * passive.atkPerDex + total.agi * passive.atkPerAgi + weight * passive.atkPerWeight)
atk_matk_basic.matk_base: (5 + total.int * 3 + floor(total.dex / 5) + (level - 1) * 0.3) * ca + floor(maxSp * passive.matkPerMaxSp + total.dex * passive.matkPerDex + total.agi * passive.matkPerAgi)
atk_matk_basic.tablet_basic_attack_rule: Royal Tablet uses atk + matk as basicStat and uses spellCritical for basic attacks

crit.crit_bypasses_flee_for_basic: Basic attack crits follow standard game hit/crit rules; skills require gs(skill) to be crit-eligible

def_mdef_pierce.player_def: min(255, floor((floor(total.vit / 15) + gearCardSet.def + passive.def + aegisDef + buff.def) * (1 + buff.statPercent.def)))
def_mdef_pierce.player_mdef: min(255, floor((floor(total.int / 10) + gearCardSet.mdef + passive.mdef + aegisMdef + buff.mdef) * (1 + buff.statPercent.mdef + (mTani ? 0.1 : 0))))
def_mdef_pierce.pierce_overcap_rule: Pierce exceeding target reduction_pct (max 85%) gives no bonus damage

max_hp_sp.body_hp: floor((floor((100 + (level - 1) * 5 + total.vit * 10) * (1 + Bn.hp)) + gearCardSet.hp + merchantOverchargeHp) * (1 + passive.maxHpPct + (hasAegis ? passive.aegisHpPct : 0) + buff.statPercent.hp))

cast_time.variable_cast_formula: dex >= 150 ? 0 : max(0, round(baseCastMs * (1 - dex / 150) * (1 - statusCastCut) * (1 - clamp(castReduce, 0, 100) / 100)))

above_150_dex_multihit_bonus.description: Above 150 DEX, multi-hit magic spells fire faster by 0.6% per DEX point up to 60% at 250 DEX

elements.weapon_coating_rule: Weapon elemental coating scrolls change ONLY basic attacks and non-fixed-element physical skills (jl); skills with a fixed element (Wl) are never overridden by weapon coating
elements.mEclipse_card_rule: Disadvantageous element cannot drop damage below 100%, but elemental advantage is capped at 115%

refine_and_sets.set_stacking_formula: ko(char) counts pieces per set across [head, face, mouth, armor, garment, shoes] and grants floor(count / set.pieces) stacks of set.bonus. Example: 6x Warlord (2pc) = 3 stacks (+30% ATK); 4x Warlord + 2x Armor Breaker = 2 stacks Warlord (+20% ATK) + 1 stack Armor Breaker (+7% Pierce); 4pc sets (Phantom/Hawkeye/Sage) allow 1 stack + 1x 2pc set; Blood Lord (6pc) requires all 6 slots.

conditional_cross_class_passives.doubleattack: Requires melee weapon (100% HIT on proc)
conditional_cross_class_passives.peratio: Active ONLY when total STR === total INT
conditional_cross_class_passives.priceceiling: Active ONLY when total STR === total INT
conditional_cross_class_passives.pricefloor: Active ONLY when total STR === total INT
conditional_cross_class_passives.vultureeye: Range applies to any ranged weapon (50% for non-Archer); bow ATK% applies only with Bow (Archer only)

flee_and_hit_roll_weights.description: Rolled independently on every slot; bucket 0..4 with sub-offset in 0..(tier-1) for buckets 0..3, exact 4*tier for bucket 4

sword.stat: atk (converted to matk if caster template has matk & no atk)

two_handed_rules.tablet_exception: Royal Tablet (slot sword, template tablet) converts raw matk to both atk=matk (1x, NOT 2x), doubles other base stats, doubles refine MATK gain, and grants BOTH +2% pierce and +2% mpierce per refine level >= +6

vit_vs_flat_hp_comparison.pve_vit_hp_multiplier_note: BodyHP is multiplied by vitHp (1 + VIT*0.006 up to 100 VIT, +0.002 per VIT above 100). On a Templar with 6000+ BodyHP, +12..18 VIT adds ~600..1500+ MaxHP, +DEF, and unlocks GLD VIT thresholds (100/200/300 -> 10x/15x/20x/25x MaxHP at Lv10), far outweighing flat hp +180.
vit_vs_flat_hp_comparison.slot_primary_stat_rules: Every gear slot rolls 1 random stat (25% chance for 2nd) from all 6 primary stats [str, agi, vit, int, dex, luk] (accessories always roll 2 distinct primary stats), plus independent FLEE & HIT rolls [0..4*tier], plus 15% (Tier V-VI) special affix from rr(slot, template). Note armor/head/face/mouth/garment/shield special affixes in rr() are ONLY defensive/regen [resBleed, resStun, resFreeze, hp, spRegen], so DPS on those slots comes primarily from primary stat rolls (e.g. STR/VIT/AGI/DEX/INT/LUK +12..+18), HIT/FLEE rolls, and Armor Sets.

mFoxTails.title: 🜂 เก้าหาง

dps_impact.effect: +12% damage vs monsters with any status ailment

mFarShot.title: 🜂 ยิงไกล

mStarShield.title: 🜂 เกราะดาว

mReef.title: 🜂 แนวปะการัง

mLure.title: 🜂 เหยื่อล่อ

dps_impact.effect: Aggro from damage x1.5

mTideSong.title: 🜂 เพลงคลื่น

mGrasp.title: 🜂 หนวดรัด

mSwarm.title: 🜂 ต่อยซ้ำ

dps_impact.effect: Consecutive hits on same monster: +2% ASPD per stack up to 10 stacks (+20% ASPD); when ASPD is capped, grants +1% damage per stack (+10% dmg)

mExecute.title: 🜂 เก็บตก

dps_impact.effect: +30% damage vs monsters below 35% HP

mBulwark.title: 🜂 กำแพงเหล็ก

dps_impact.effect: Party members within 200px take -10% monster damage

mTitan.title: 🜂 ผ่าบัลลังก์
mTitan.description: ดาเมจใส่ Leader และบอส +25% · ใส่มอนธรรมดา −10%

dps_impact.effect: +25% damage vs Leader & Bosses; -10% damage vs normal monsters

mMoonDust.title: 🜂 ฝุ่นจันทร์
mMoonDust.description: หลบการตีหรือสกิลของมอนได้ การตีที่โดนครั้งถัดไปภายใน 3 วินาทีคริติคอลแน่นอน (ทุก 2 วินาที)

mFullMoon.title: 🜂 จันทร์เต็มดวง

dps_impact.effect: Restore 2% MaxSP on monster kill (stacks up to 3 cards)

mLowGravity.title: 🜂 แรงโน้มถ่วงต่ำ
mLowGravity.description: โดนมอนตีจนตาย เหลือ HP 1 และมอนทำร้ายไม่ได้ 2 วินาที แล้วพัก 90 วินาที (ไม่ทำงานระหว่าง Nine Lives หรือ Last Stand พัก)

mEclipse.title: 🜂 สุริยคราส

mQuake.title: 🜂 เขี้ยวแผ่นดินไหว

mHug.title: 🜂 กอดแน่น

mBounce.title: 🜂 เด้งหลบ
